title: Regime program: know WHEN each strategy is primed to perform (regime ML check-in, wide regime-classification research, good-vs-bad-trade condition separation, baseline structure/momentum direction model) + an extensive work plan
owner: manager (normal queue position, NOT front of line; dispatch when a research lane is free)
note: [2026-10-11T06:35Z operator request, paraphrased closely] Not top priority, but it must get into the line. Intent: many strategies do well sometimes and badly at others; we may be missing the bigger picture of WHEN to apply each strategy, rather than only tweaking strategies (also important, not the only lever). Central goal toward a fully automated AI trader. Deliverables: (1) CHECK-IN on the ML regime classifier started earlier: what exists (models, datasets, registry stage, live/advisory use), how it is doing, what stalled; (2) WIDE RESEARCH on regime-classification approaches (rule-based ADX/vol/trend axes, HMM/clustering, supervised advisory heads, cross-sectional fleet regime, transition-lag, etc.), compared on the one metric that matters: does it separate a strategy's good from bad trades net of cost; (3) GOOD-vs-BAD TRADE condition study: from backtest ledgers per strategy, can market conditions at entry distinguish winners from losers well enough to gate/weight (per-leg and per-family, pre-registered, out-of-sample); (4) BASELINE market structure + momentum function: a basic, documented model predicting up vs down (and conditions), plus signal combination, as a reusable baseline other work is measured against; (5) an EXTENSIVE WORK PLAN as research/queue units with pre-registered rules. Absorbs REGIME-SCOPE (history + impact scoping + next units; prior results 701/702/E38 trend-axis null, 704 vol-axis FAIL power-bounded, 703 selection-sensitivity) and REGIME-WEIGHT-VARIANTS (soft-weight build blocking RQ-20260927-006..009) as children: start from them, do not redo them. Done = check-in written with measured state, work plan landed as queue units (runnable or with named blockers), and the first wave run and read out.
